==80%==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |Which of these is not a girl’s name?
|-
|LC
|KT
|IV
|'''EW'''
|}
When the letters are said out loud, they sound like girls’ names. So LC sounds like Elsie, KT sounds like Katie and IV sounds like Ivy. Whereas EW is just Ew.
